title: Add llm req CLI argument parsing
objective: Recognize llm req <request-name> <request-parameters>, resolve the request schema before dynamic parameter parsing, and preserve current modes and common format/debug flags. Contract sections: requests/README.md#library-and-cli-boundaries; requests/README.md#parameter-contract. Explicit human operator confirmation is required before modifying requests/README.md.

branch.name: llm-request-lookup
branch.rationale: The record captures bounded planning without creating or switching a branch.

request.text: Prepare small, testable work items for dynamic request lookup: document requests/README.md; support request asset discovery; schema-aware CLI parameters including dot/index paths and --parameters JSON; $${variableName}$$ substitution; completeRequest({ requestName, parameters, files, ... }); llm req CLI integration; raw/full output; summarize compatibility; provider-free validation.

scope.name: req-shape
scope.description: The parser recognizes req with a request name and parameter tail.

scope.name: common-output-flags
scope.description: Dynamic requests accept existing raw/full and debug controls in common positions.

scope.name: parameter-forwarding
scope.description: The parser resolves the request schema before interpreting unmatched argv keys, then forwards --parameters and schema-defined property tokens to completeRequest.

scope.name: existing-modes
scope.description: Existing parser modes retain their shapes and exit codes.
scope.reason: The new branch must be additive.

scope.name: authoritative-contract
scope.description: Implement only the authoritative contract sections [Library and CLI boundaries](#library-and-cli-boundaries), [Parameter contract](#parameter-contract). Do not modify requests/README.md without explicit human operator confirmation.
scope.reason: The request README is the source of truth for this implementation batch.

nonGoals.name: implementation
nonGoals.description: Do not implement behavior outside this work item.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-release
nonGoals.description: Do not make authenticated calls, publish, deploy, or claim production readiness.

nonGoals.name: unrelated-refactor
nonGoals.description: Do not redesign unrelated commands, providers, schemas, or persistence.
nonGoals.reason: Scope is limited to dynamic request lookup.
